mapper.select: SELECT IMAGE_PATH, BANNER FROM ( SELECT PI.PRODUCT_ID, PI.PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH AS IMAGE_PATH, PI.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME AS BANNER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PI.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY PI.PRODUCT_IMAGE_ID) AS RN FROM PRODUCTIMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0 ) WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY PRODUCT_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_NAME FROM CATEGORY ORDER BY CATEGORY_ID
SELECT TAG_ID, TAG_NAME, TAG_COLOR FROM TAG ORDER BY TAG_ID
